title: Design: After Remove the Confirmation shows again and Pays for is gone
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer P with no work orders, assets or contacts, saved as customer Q's Bill Invoices To.
  • Start on the Remove as default Bill To window for customer P.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p6-07-after-after-remove.png, bt-p6-08-after-result.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click Remove.
  2. Click Cancel in the Confirmation window.
  3. Close Edit Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window closes and the delete Confirmation window shows again.

Step 2:

  • The Confirmation closes.

Step 3:

  • Customer P's card shows only Contacts and Assets: no Pays for counter.
  • Customer Q's page shows no Bill Invoices To line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12314 (Story 12, Deleting a customer that pays for others)

  • S12-R5: “Confirming clears the saved default on every dependent customer; open work orders keep their Bill To.”
  • S12-R6: “The user then deletes the customer again.”
  • S1-N4: “The "Pays for" counter is hidden when the count is 0.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "6 Deleting a customer that pays for others", pictures "After Remove" (New, no before exists), "Result" (New, no before exists).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p6-07-after-after-remove.png
  • bt-p6-08-after-result.png

The design's own words:

  • “Reloaded: no "Pays for" counter. Valders now bills itself for new work.”

The attached picture still shows "Pays for" 1 although its note says it disappears at once; the counter is expected to be gone.
